$comment: Quality gates for the qa, spec-build and spec-check skills (node .agents/skills/qa/scripts/gates.mjs fast|full) and the Claude Code hooks in .claude/hooks/. `full` mirrors .github/workflows/ci.yml (minus the pincel-tauri job, AGENTS.md §10); `fast` runs in the Stop hook, filtered by `paths` (prefixes of changed repository paths). `needs` lists the ids a gate waits for; gates without needs between them run in parallel. Optional per gate: `fix` (auto-fix command), `note` (guidance when it is red).

fast.name: clippy
fast.command: cargo clippy -p pincel-core -p pincel-effects -p pincel-trace -p pincel-ocr -p aseprite-writer -p pincel-wasm -p pincel-image-core -p pincel-image-wasm -p pincel-agent -p pincel-mcp --all-targets -- -D warnings

full.name: clippy
full.command: cargo clippy -p pincel-core -p pincel-effects -p pincel-trace -p pincel-ocr -p aseprite-writer -p pincel-wasm -p pincel-image-core -p pincel-image-wasm -p pincel-agent -p pincel-mcp --all-targets -- -D warnings

full.name: cargo test
full.command: cargo test -p pincel-core -p pincel-effects -p pincel-trace -p pincel-ocr -p aseprite-writer -p pincel-wasm -p pincel-image-core -p pincel-image-wasm -p pincel-agent -p pincel-mcp

full.name: generated TS bindings current
full.note: Red when cargo test regenerated ui/src/modes/image/core/generated/: the regenerated files belong in the commit — review and include them, don't revert them.

full.name: agent skills in sync
full.note: Shared skills are edited in amigo-labs/skills and synced with `node .agents/sync.mjs`; this repository's own skills are edited in .agents/skills, then `node .agents/sync.mjs --mirror`.
